recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現數顆典型漿細胞：核偏位、染色質塊狀、豐富深藍色胞質並有核周淡染區（hof），背景紅血球呈錢串狀，提示漿細胞白血病。
features: Several mature-appearing plasma cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm
Round eccentric nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Smaller plasmacytoid cell at left with eccentric nucleus and less cytoplasm
Red cells stacked in rouleaux in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a well-defined perinuclear hof. A smaller plasmacytoid cell is also present. The red cells show rouleaux formation. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia if circulating plasma cells reach at least 5% of leukocytes.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are sparse and polytypic, typically with infection or serum sickness, and no monoclonal protein.
LPL is dominated by small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei with cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells and lack a crisp perinuclear hof.
